title: Root canal retreatment
what: The dentist opens a tooth that was treated before, removes the old filling from the canals, cleans them and fills them again.
why: When a tooth hurts after earlier treatment, there is inflammation at the root on the X-ray, or a crown is needed on a tooth with poorly filled canals.
duration: usually 1 to 2 hours, often in 2 to 3 visits
tell_doctor: When and where the tooth was treated before, if you know
Whether the tooth hurts and whether there was swelling
Allergies, especially to anesthetics and antibiotics
Illnesses and medicines, especially blood thinners

prepare.title: X-rays
prepare.text: A fresh X-ray or 3D scan of the tooth is usually needed.

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: Eat 1 to 2 hours before the visit.

bring: Old X-rays of the tooth, if you have them
steps: The tooth is kept dry with a rubber sheet
The old filling or crown is removed
The old material is taken out of the canals
The canals are cleaned and rinsed
Sometimes medicine is placed until the next visit
The canals are filled and the tooth is closed with a temporary or permanent filling
feel: Keeping your mouth open for long is tiring
Afterward the tooth may ache for a few days
after: Do not chew on this side while the temporary filling is in
Take pain relief as the doctor recommends
Come to all the visits you were given
After treatment the tooth is usually covered with a crown or inlay. The doctor will tell you
red_flags: Swelling of the cheek or gum
Severe pain that keeps getting worse
Fever above 38 with a swollen face

faq.q: Why does the tooth need treatment again?
faq.a: Sometimes infection stays in the canals or the filling is not tight. Then inflammation develops at the root.

faq.q: Can I leave it if it doesn't hurt?
faq.a: Inflammation can go on without pain. Make the decision together with the doctor.

reminders.text: Root canal treatment tomorrow. Eat 1 to 2 hours before the visit and bring your old X-rays.
